content: Catechu, also referred to as cutch, cashoo, or Japan earth, is an extract derived from various species of the Acacia tree, most notably Acacia catechu. The extract is obtained by boiling the wood of the tree in water and subsequently evaporating the resulting liquid to concentrate it. In Hindi, catechu is known as katha. It possesses astringent properties and has been utilized since ancient times in Ayurvedic medicine. Additionally, it has been incorporated into spice mixtures designed to freshen breath. Black catechu has recently been employed by Blavod Drinks Ltd. to impart a black color to their vodka. This substance, also called cutch, serves as a brown dye and is widely used in tanning and dyeing processes. It is also utilized for preserving fishing nets and sails. White cutch, which is alternatively known as gambier, gambeer, or gambir, shares similar applications to black catechu.
